import sys,random
sys.path.insert(0,'submission')
from service import Controller
random.seed(2026)
for repeat in range(20000):
 c=Controller();M=random.randint(0,8);caps=[random.randrange(20) for _ in range(M)]
 for i in range(random.randrange(15)):
  s=random.randrange(20);e=random.randrange(s+1,21)
  env=[[l,random.randrange(1,12)] for l in range(M) if random.randrange(2)]
  c.live[str(i)]={'window':[s,e],'envelope':env}
 s=random.randrange(21);e=random.randrange(s+1,23)
 off=[[l,random.randrange(1,12)] for l in range(M) if random.randrange(2)]
 hit=c.overbook(caps,s,e,off)
 truth=[]
 for t in range(s,e):
  used=[0]*M
  for l,r in off:used[l]+=r
  for b in c.live.values():
   if b['window'][0]<=t<b['window'][1]:
    for l,r in b['envelope']:used[l]+=r
  truth.extend((l,t,u,caps[l]) for l,u in enumerate(used) if u>caps[l])
 assert bool(hit)==bool(truth)
 if hit: assert hit in truth
print('20000 independent capacity sweeps passed')
